claims.statement: CĐ04–CĐ06 are migrated as one Golden Template batch with Learn, Practice Room and Core Readiness layers.
Each topic has five Core Learning Cards and exactly 15 authored micro-practice items in Base → Trap → Apply order.
Each topic has 10 actual Core written exercises with collapsed solutions, plus separated Entrance10 and Challenge work.
Each topic has 10 MCQ-only Core Readiness items using Assessment Engine v1 semantics.
CĐ06 Core contains neither tach-hang-tu-giua nor giai-pt-bang-nhan-tu. Those are explicitly Extension/Entrance10.
CĐ05 Core does not assess giai-phuong-trinh-hdt/chung-minh-hdt/phan-tich-hdt as generic skills.
CĐ04 Practice Bank gains 12 real division-by-monomial questions so the new Core skill is not orphaned.
The Learning Workspace runtime is generalized from CĐ07 to CĐ04–CĐ07 using topic-specific data rather than separate JavaScript implementations.
CĐ04 preserves the Grade 7 → Grade 8 Vertical Spine; one-variable polynomial recognition remains within nhan-biet-da-thuc while division by monomial is modeled explicitly.

proposed_changes.change: Publish CĐ04–CĐ06 as one production batch if CI, strict MkDocs build and deploy QA pass.
proposed_changes.rationale: Golden Template v1 is frozen and the same runtime/data contracts are reused.

tests.expected: JS syntax and workspace↔micro↔assessment structural checks pass.
45 micro items: exactly one assessed skill, 4 unique options, 2-level hints, no forbidden Core skills.
30 Readiness items: MCQ-only, 10/topic, no forbidden Core skills.
CĐ04 manifest declares and actually loads 132 unique questions including 12 division items.
Practice Room provides >=8 actual Core written exercises/topic with hidden solutions plus Extension/Challenge.
Deploy CI + strict MkDocs build pass.

uncertainties: Browser smoke QA after deploy is still useful, but no new UI schema is introduced beyond the already frozen CĐ07 Golden Template.

acceptance.notes: Content/schema/structural QA passed. Publish as one batch after CI/deploy; rejected Gemini scope/schema items remain excluded.
